pages.title: African Wild Dog
pages.text: The African wild dog ($(o)Lycaon pictus$()), also called the painted wolf, is a canid native to the savannas and woodlands of sub-Saharan Africa.$(br2)Its mottled coat of black, brown, yellow and white is unique to each individual, and unlike other canids it has only four toes on its forefeet.$(br2)Wild dogs live in close-knit packs that hunt together and feed their pups by regurgitating meat.
